description: This file is a JavaScript source file for the Materialize CSS framework, containing utility functions, component base class, and several component implementations like Collapsible. It also includes code for jQuery wrappers, event handling, and UI interaction logic.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A generic base class for all Materialize components, providing initialization, destruction, and multiple instance support.

classes.name: Collapsible
classes.description: Materialize UI component for collapsible content panels with options for accordion or expandable behavior, including event handling and animations.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: Component providing dropdown menu functionality with positioning, event handling, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Component for creating modal dialogs with overlay, animations, and event handling for open/close actions.

classes.name: Materialbox
classes.description: Component for enlarging images in a modal overlay with animation effects.

classes.name: Parallax
classes.description: Visual component creating parallax scrolling effects on images.

classes.name: Tabs

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Component providing tooltip popups with positioning, animations, and event handling.

classes.name: Waves
classes.description: Wave effect touch ripple animation for click interactions.

classes.name: Toast
classes.description: Component for showing transient toast notifications with auto dismiss and swipe support.

classes.name: Sidenav
classes.description: Side navigation drawer with overlay, swipe gestures, fixed positioning, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Component to track sections in view and update navigation or indicators accordingly.

classes.name: Autocomplete
classes.description: Input auto-complete component with dropdown results, keyboard navigation, and custom sorting.

classes.name: Autocomplete
classes.description: Component providing an input autocomplete dropdown with filtering, keyboard navigation, and custom sorting.

classes.name: Chips
classes.description: Component for managing input chips/tags, with support for autocomplete, adding, deleting, and selecting chips.

classes.name: Pushpin
classes.description: Component that pins elements to the top or bottom of viewport during scroll, with callbacks for position changes.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton
classes.description: Component for a floating action button with animated expansion in different directions or as a toolbar.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: Component for selecting dates with calendar UI, supporting internationalization, min/max ranges, and custom formats.

classes.name: Slider
classes.description: Component implementing an image/content slider with indicators, auto-sliding, and transition controls.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Component for creating modal dialogs with overlays, animations, and focus trapping.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: Component for selecting dates with calendar UI, supporting internationalization, min/max ranges, and custom formats. It handles rendering calendar tables, managing date state, modal interactions, and event handling for date selection.

classes.name: Timepicker
classes.description: Component for selecting times with analog clock and digital display. It provides methods to open/close modal dialogs, handle clock interactions, manage time state, and format/display selected time.

classes.name: CharacterCounter
classes.description: Component that displays and manages character count for input fields, validating maximum length and updating display accordingly.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Component for creating and managing carousel/slideshow of items with support for touch/mouse interactions, indicators, and dynamic resizing.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Component for creating and managing carousels/sliders with support for touch/mouse interactions, indicators, and responsiveness.

classes.name: TapTarget
classes.description: Component for feature discovery overlays, highlighting UI elements with an informational popup.

classes.name: FormSelect
classes.description: Component that replaces native select elements with styled dropdowns supporting single/multiple selections.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Component for range sliders with custom thumb and bubble display, supporting various interactions and animations.
